description: Add a credential to the vault WITHOUT it passing through this conversation. A secure input box opens on the user's screen; they paste the value there and it is encrypted straight into the vault. You get back only a confirmation. ALWAYS use this instead of asking the user to paste a key into the chat. Give a set name (created if it doesn't already exist) and either a known service (hush knows which variables it needs, e.g. 'fal') or a bare key.

account.description: Deprecated (removed in hush 2.0), used with service — together they mean set "service/account".

env.description: Deprecated alias for "set", removed in hush 2.0.

key.description: A single variable name, if this isn't a known service.

service.description: Deprecated alias (removed in hush 2.0): e.g. 'fal'. hush knows which variables it needs.

set.description: The set to add this to, e.g. 'work-fal'. Created if absent. Default: the project's default set.

where.description: Where to create a new set: this project's vault (default) or the user's own library.

why.description: Shown to the user so they know what they are approving.

name: hush_add_secret
